Tofacitinib citrate is a pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine derivative, and the finished tablets are put up in measured doses for retail sale, so they fall under heading 3004. Within that heading, the likely subheading is 3004.90 (other medicaments), and the 10-digit statistical suffix is 3004.90.9250 or similar.

I recall CBP rulings on tofacitinib tablets (Xeljanz) that classify them in 3004.90.9250, "Other: Other: Other: Other", though I'm not certain of the suffix. The 3004.90.92 breakout covers "Other" items, and within it:
- 3004.90.9215 is for medicaments for... (uncertain)
- 3004.90.9230 is for antiasthmatics and similar
- 3004.90.9250 is for other medicaments for the treatment of arthritis or other inflammatory conditions, e.g., "Other" (uncertain)

I recall 3004.90.9255 as "Anti-inflammatories / arthritis". My best guess is 3004.90.9250, but I can't verify the suffix.
